title: Project Spotlight - Crowne Plaza Hobart
bodyHtml:
This month's Project Spotlight features our Metamorfosi Series in gorgeous black and white.

"Located in the city centre, Crowne Plaza Hobart connects it’s visitors, business or leisure, to the heart of Tasmania. A warm welcome to Tasmania’s capital, this contemporary hotel offers well thought out spaces to connect and recharge and modern rooms designed to ensure you rest and relax while making the most out of your stay."

Our Metamorfosi above counter basins are striking statement pieces in this stunning eclectic bathroom setting designed by Joseph Pang Design Group.

Design by: Joseph Pang Design Group
Client: IHG

 

Thanks for reading!
